title: Heat Stroke
author: Nicholas Rockstroh
problems: Couples don't end the round where the progression puts them.
choices: Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
Taking hands at the end of a hey is left to the long waves that follow.
